_about: The only business facts the agency may state. Every fact carries the exact text that proves it on the live site; `agency facts verify` re-fetches each source and blocks any creative that relies on a fact whose evidence has disappeared. status=usable may be stated; status=restricted needs an operator to substantiate it before copy may rely on it.

facts.statement: TSE has supplied printer consumables in South Africa since 1987.
facts.evidence: TSE has supplied printer consumables in South Africa since 1987

facts.statement: TSE is family-run, from Unit 34, A.P.D. Industrial Park, Kya Sands, Johannesburg.
facts.evidence: Family-run from Unit 34, Kya Sands Industrial

facts.statement: TSE's compatible cartridges are made by third parties to fit the listed printers; brand names identify printers only.
facts.evidence: they are not made by the printer manufacturer, and we don't claim otherwise
facts.rule: Never say 'HP toner' or 'genuine'. Say 'compatible with HP ...'.

facts.statement: Using a compatible cartridge does not void your printer's warranty.
allowed_phrasings: Using a compatible cartridge doesn't void your printer's warranty
facts.evidence: Using a compatible cartridge does not void your printer's warranty

facts.statement: If a TSE cartridge is faulty, TSE replaces it.
allowed_phrasings: If a cartridge fails, we replace it
facts.evidence: If a cartridge fails, we replace it

facts.statement: Faulty cartridges are covered for 6 months from delivery: repair, replacement or refund, at the customer's choice; TSE pays collection.
Order before noon and choose Overnight for next-business-day delivery to Johannesburg and Pretoria.
allowed_phrasings: Order by noon, on your desk tomorrow (Overnight, JHB & PTA)
facts.evidence: Next-day delivery to JHB/PTA on Overnight
facts.rule: Always carry both conditions: before noon AND Overnight AND JHB/PTA only. Never 'next-day nationwide'.

facts.statement: Orders placed before noon are dispatched the same day.
allowed_phrasings: Order before noon for same-day dispatch
facts.evidence: Order before noon for same-day dispatch

facts.statement: TSE delivers countrywide by courier (The Courier Guy); collection from the Kya Sands warehouse is free.
facts.evidence: collection from our Kya Sands warehouse is always free

facts.statement: Delivery is free on orders over R2,000.
facts.rule: Commercial terms change: re-verified before every publish.

facts.statement: TSE stocks cartridges for 12 printer brands: Brother, Canon, Epson, HP, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, Lexmark, OKI, Pantum, Ricoh, Samsung and Xerox.
The site finds every cartridge that fits a given printer model.
allowed_phrasings: Tell us your printer. We'll do the rest.
facts.evidence: Tell us your printer. We'll do the rest.

facts.statement: Offices, schools and print shops can get business pricing by quote (011 708 2304, sales@tse.co.za).
Prices on the site include VAT.
TSE's compatibles cost a fraction of the original-brand price.
facts.evidence: at a fraction of the price
facts.rule: General, unquantified only. Any number (%, rand saving) must come from a live product comparison, which this system does not yet have.

facts.statement: Average 60% cost-per-page reduction vs matching OEM across the top 50 SKUs.
facts.rule: Client-stated statistic with no substantiation on file. Blocked until the client supplies the calculation.

facts.statement: Compatibles meet or exceed OEM page yield.
facts.evidence: meet or exceed OEM page yield
facts.rule: Comparative performance claim; blocked until substantiated. Page yields are disputed (tse-rework #519).

facts.statement: Compatibles are guaranteed to work as well as the original; if not, TSE replaces them.
allowed_phrasings: If it doesn't print like the original, we replace it
facts.evidence: If it doesn't print as well as the original — we replace it
facts.rule: Always pair with the replacement promise. Never 'better than the original'.

never: Discounts, sales, promo codes or limited-time offers unless an operator adds them here with dates
Specific prices, page yields or percentages not in this file
Testimonials, review scores or customer counts
'Better than original', 'genuine', 'OEM', or a printer brand's logo or packaging
Delivery promises beyond the exact conditions above
